title: 第9章  风雨欲来又怎么样？依旧老婆孩子热坑头
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
content_zh:
李长生点点头，安慰：“也许明天一早就回来了。”
江翠萍闻言，放下心来：“那就好，夫君你也早点休息吧。”
李长生点点头：
“嗯，你先睡。”
“我再坐一会。”
看着妻子进房的背影，李长生脸上的笑容，瞬间消失得无影无踪。
一天时间过去了。
杜老头没有回来。
似乎自己的猜测变成了现实。
第二天。
李长生依然坐在院子藤椅上，懒洋洋地晒太阳。
但是心已经沉下去。
杜老头贪财不假。
好色也不假。
但他更惜命。
家里还有个娇滴滴的小媳妇。
才区区几十块灵石，不足以让他抛妻弃家，远走高飞。
如果路是通的。
早就该回来了。
安置区内更安静了。

就连平日里聚在一起吹牛的老头们，也一个个闭门不出。
仿佛大家都预感到了什么。
空气中弥漫着压抑的气息。
第三天深夜。
李长生盘膝，坐在昏暗的客厅里，没有点灯。
如同融入了黑暗的雕塑。
三天三夜了。
杜老头依旧杳无音讯。
答案已经显而易见了。
“自己的猜测已经成为现实。”
“杜老头回不来了。”
李长生缓缓吐出一口浊气，站起身，走到窗边，透过缝隙，看向外面漆黑的夜色，复杂的心情夹带着愤怒。
这就是瓮中捉鳖啊。
把所有人圈禁起来。
想什么时候杀，
就什么时候杀。
想杀几个，
就杀几个。
绝望吗？
有一点。

但更多的是一种被逼到墙角的狠厉。
既然出不去。
就只能拼命活着了。
苟修被逼到绝路也是会杀人的。
李长生大脑飞速运转，分析着眼前破局之法。
如今局面已是死局。
肯定不行。
谢剑是筑基期修士。
既然敢布下大阵，肯定还有后手。
甚至还有同伙。
凭练气九层的修为。
带着老婆孩子硬闯。
跟送死没有什么区别。
李长生是一个稳健的人，绝对不会冒这么大风险的。
那么……
将这里的信息传递给青云宗高层？
这是一个思路。
毕竟这里是青云宗脚下，谢剑只是外门长老，肯定不能只手遮天。
宗门内肯定还有正义之士。
只要能把这里【被圈养】、【被屠杀】的消息传出去，引起宗门重视，谢剑就不敢轻举妄动。

怎么传？
人出不去。
传音符估计也被阵法隔绝了。
除非能找到阵法的薄弱点，或者等到谢剑开启阵法的瞬间，将求救信物送出去。
这很难。
且充满了不确定。
万一青云宗高层也是一丘之貉呢？
岂不是自投罗网？
李长生揉了揉眉心。
“看来靠天靠地，不如靠自己。”
“唯有变强啊！”
“自己的实力才是判定能否活着的唯一标准。”
李长生将目光转向里屋内，看着自己妻子微微隆起的肚子，道心更坚定了。
其实算算时间。
江翠萍也就还有一个月左右，就生二胎了。
按照系统的尿性，第二个子嗣诞生的奖励，绝对会非常丰厚。
这是变数。
也是自己翻盘的机会。
但在这之前。
必须苟住。

藏底牌。
炼神通。
默默发育。
不惹事。
不出头。
主动避开麻烦。
只有这样才能争取到最后的时间。
“杜老头。”
“你的死不会没有价值的。”
“至少让我知道了咱们无法出去了。”
李长生低声喃喃，随后转身，走进密室。
既然出不去。
就用仅剩的时间，画符、布置陷阱，稳健到极致。
虽然安置区的大多数人，都是老弱病残。
但他们都是在修仙界摸爬滚打一辈子的老油条。
对危险的嗅觉，是很敏感的。
尤其是一些在安置区生活了几代人的修士，关系盘综错节，早就感觉到了不对劲。
有危险。
便会躲开。
这是所有动物的天性。

在接下来的几天时间里，又有几个散修，准备离开安置区。
而且是从不同的方向离开的。
结果无一例外。
全部石沉大海。
活不见人。
死不见尸。
只剩下那些散修的妻子，以及后代，哭得撕心裂肺。
恐慌如同瘟疫般蔓延。
死气沉沉的安置区变得躁动不安。
当然也有李长生的暗中推波助澜的功劳。
既然无法解决麻烦。
那就将麻烦扩大。
将麻烦扩大之后，可能会死得更快，但是也会有更多的机会。
“我们要见长老。”
“为什么封锁出路？我们只是下山养老，不是坐牢。”
“放我们出去。”
“还有为什么安置区，会频繁有人失踪？没有人处理吗？”
“到底发生了什么？”
“谁能告诉我？”
几十名稍微有些修为的老修，聚集在安置区广场，大声抗议。

他们在这里乱了几个钟了。
其中也有执法弟子来这里视察。
按道理来说。
这里的消息应该早就传递上去了。
但是就是没有青云宗的人出现。
这让躲在暗处观察的李长生非常无奈。
半小时后。
众人越发群情激昂。
许是幕后的人，看到事态越来越不可控了，终于出现了。
“肃静！”
突然一道惊雷般的呵斥声，在众人耳边炸响。
紧接着。
三道流光从天而降。
为首之人，一袭锦衣，背负长剑，神情倨傲。正是庶务长老，谢剑。
谢剑身后跟着两名执事。
皆是练气大圆满的修为。
李长生躲在角落位置，看到谢剑出现，心头更凝重了。
果然……
上不达天听啊！
费心费力，将事情搞大，还只是引来了谢剑一伙人。

李长生心底吐槽一声，随后将目光落在谢剑旁边的两位执事。
这两位执事并不是前几天在谢剑旁布阵的年轻男子。
这让他眉头皱得更深了。
因为涉及人员越多。
事情就越复杂。
谢剑凌空而立，筑基期威压释放，如同大山压下。
原本喧闹的广场。
瞬间变得鸦雀无声。
刚才还叫嚣着要讨个说法的老修们，一个个噤若寒蝉。
“吵什么？”
“本座布下大阵，是为了你们好。”
“最近安置区频繁有人失踪，此乃是外面的魔修作乱。”
“布阵乃是守护你们的安全。”
这理由很好。
逻辑也很合理。
只是真的是为了我们好吗？
众人面面相觑，敢怒不敢言。
这时谢剑顿了顿，又接着开口：
“你们要相信宗门。”
“等宗门解决了安置区人员频繁失踪问题后，自然会撤去大阵。”

“但是在阵法开启期间，所有人不可擅自离开。”
“若擅自闯阵，被阵法反噬而死，就别怪本座没提醒过他了。”
随着谢剑的声音落下，人群中几位老修，大声高呼。许是谢剑安排在人群中的托儿。
“原来是这样……”
“多谢长老庇护！”
“长老英明！”
其他人见状。
虽然心中仍有疑虑，但在筑基威压下，也只能无奈跟着附和，稀稀拉拉地跪了一地。
这就是弱者的悲哀。
明知道是谎言。
却连戳穿的勇气都没有。
谢剑看着下方跪倒一片的蝼蚁，眼中闪过一丝不屑。
“既然明白了，就都散了吧。”
“安心待在家里，不要乱跑。”
“等宗门调查清楚后，阵法自然会撤去。”
说完，谢剑袖袍一挥，带着两名执事化作流光离去。
只留下一群面面相觑的老修。
其实他们也知道事情不对劲。
只是他们敢反抗吗？
敢不了一点。

李长生混在人群中，禁不住吐槽。
“魔修？”
“保护我们？”
“真是既当婊子又立牌坊。”
“这所谓的魔修，恐怕就是你们自己吧？”
随后深吸一口气。
转身悄无声息地消失在人群中。
回到家。
李长生立刻关紧了门窗。
在原本的防御阵法之外，又加了一层【隔绝窥探】的禁制。
江翠萍坐在床边缝制着小衣服。
宁宁在旁边玩耍。
江翠萍看到李长生回来，顶着大肚子，艰难站起来，迎上去，问道：
“夫君，外面怎么样了？我听到好大的动静。”
李长生握住江翠萍的手。
“没事。”
“是宗门长老来了。”
“说是外面有魔修作乱，为了保护大家，才开启了阵法。”
李长生并没有把真相全部告诉她。
孕妇的情绪需要稳定。

哪怕是善意的谎言。
也是为了保护她和肚子里的孩子。
“真的吗？”江翠萍有些怀疑。
“当然是真的。”
“这里可是青云宗脚下，长老也是青云宗的长老，怎么会骗人呢？”
李长生笑着刮了刮江翠萍的鼻子，声音有些自嘲。
只是江翠萍一介凡人根本没有听出来。
“那就好……”
“只要我们一家人平平安安的就好。”江翠萍抚摸着隆起的小腹。
“嗯。”
“我们一定会平平安安的。”
李长生将江翠萍揽入怀中，伛偻的背影中，透露着一丝爱意。
这时闺女宁宁走到李长生旁边，奶声奶气地开口：
“爹爹。”
“我也要抱抱。”
哈哈……
“好，宁宁也要抱抱。”
李长生说着，张开怀抱，将自家闺女也抱入怀中。
“爹爹。”
“要举高高。”

宁宁扎着双马尾辫，脸蛋粉妆玉砌，就像瓷娃娃一样，非常好看。也不知道怎么回事，宁宁从小就很粘父亲的。
content_en:
Li Changsheng nodded and comforted: "Maybe he will be back early tomorrow morning."
Hearing this, Jiang Cuiping felt relieved and said, "That's good. Husband, you should also rest early."
Li Changsheng nodded:
"Well, you go to bed first."
"I'll sit down for a while."
Seeing his wife's back entering the room, the smile on Li Changsheng's face disappeared without a trace in an instant.
One day passed.
Old man Du didn't come back.
It seems that my guess has become a reality.
the next day.
Li Changsheng was still sitting on the wicker chair in the yard, lazily basking in the sun.
But my heart has sunk.
It is true that Old Man Du is greedy for money.
It's not fake to be lustful.
But he cherishes his life even more.
There is also a delicate little daughter-in-law at home.
Just a few dozen spiritual stones were not enough to allow him to abandon his wife and family and fly away.
If the road is open.
It's long past time to come back.
The resettlement area is quieter.
Even the old men who usually get together to brag are staying behind closed doors.
It seemed that everyone had a premonition of something.
There is a depressing atmosphere in the air.
Late at night on the third day.
Li Changsheng sat cross-legged in the dark living room without lighting the lamp.
Like a sculpture immersed in darkness.
Three days and three nights.
There is still no news from Old Man Du.
The answer is already obvious.
"My guess has become a reality."
"Old man Du can't come back."
Li Changsheng slowly exhaled a breath, stood up, walked to the window, and looked out at the dark night through the gap, with complicated emotions mixed with anger.
This is catching a turtle in a urn.
Lock everyone up.
Kill whenever you want,
Just kill when.
I want to kill a few,
Just kill a few.
Desperate?
A little bit.
But it's more of a ruthlessness of being forced into a corner.
Since I can't get out.
I can only survive as hard as I can.
Gou Xiu will kill someone if he is cornered.
Li Changsheng's brain was running rapidly, analyzing the way to break the situation in front of him.
The situation is now a dead end.
Definitely not.
Xie Jian is a monk in the foundation building stage.
Since he dares to set up a large formation, he must have a back-up plan.
There are even accomplices.
With the cultivation of the ninth level of Qi training.
Take your wife and children to break in.
It's no different than sending yourself to death.
Li Changsheng is a steady person and will never take such a big risk.
So...
Pass the information here to the senior officials of Qingyun Sect?
This is an idea.
After all, this is the foothold of Qingyun Sect, and Xie Jian is only an outer sect elder, so he certainly cannot cover the sky with just one hand.
There must be some righteous people in the sect.
As long as the news of [being held in captivity] and [being massacred] here could be spread and attract the attention of the sect, Xie Jian would not dare to act rashly.
How to pass it on?
No one can get out.
The transmission talisman was probably also isolated by the formation.
Unless the weak point of the formation can be found, or the moment Xie Jian activates the formation, he can send out the rescue token.
It's hard.
And full of uncertainty.
What if the senior officials of Qingyun Sect are also the same?
Wouldn't it be like throwing yourself into a trap?
Li Changsheng rubbed his eyebrows.
"It seems that it is better to rely on heaven and earth than to rely on yourself."
"The only way is to become stronger!"
"Your own strength is the only criterion to determine whether you can survive."
Li Changsheng turned his gaze to the inner room and looked at his wife's slightly swollen belly, his heart became firmer.
Actually count the time.
Jiang Cuiping is only about a month away from giving birth to her second child.
According to the urine properties of the system, the reward for the birth of the second child will definitely be very generous.
This is a variable.
It’s also an opportunity for you to make a comeback.
But not before that.
Must survive.
Hide your trump card.
Refining magical powers.
Develop silently.
Don't cause trouble.
Don't stand out.
Take the initiative to avoid trouble.
Only in this way can we gain the final time.
"Old man Du."
"Your death will not be without value."
"At least let me know that we can't go out."
Li Changsheng murmured in a low voice, then turned around and walked into the secret room.
Since I can't get out.
At onceUse the remaining time to draw symbols and set traps, and be as stable as possible.
Although most people in the resettlement area are old, weak, sick and disabled.
But they are all veterans who have spent their entire lives in the world of immortality.
He is very sensitive to the smell of danger.
Especially some monks who have lived in the resettlement area for several generations have complicated relationships and have long felt that something is wrong.
There is danger.
Will avoid it.
This is the nature of all animals.
In the next few days, several more casual cultivators were preparing to leave the resettlement area.
And leaving from different directions.
The results are without exception.
All fell into the sea.
Live without seeing anyone.
No body is seen after death.
Only the wives and descendants of the casual cultivators were left crying heartbrokenly.
Panic spread like a plague.
The lifeless settlement area became restless.
Of course, Li Changsheng also took credit for secretly fueling the situation.
Since the trouble cannot be solved.
That will increase the trouble.
By expanding the trouble, you may die faster, but you will also have more opportunities.
"We need to see the elders."
"Why are the exits blocked? We are just going down the mountain to live in retirement, not in jail."
"Let us out."
"And why do people disappear frequently in the resettlement area? Isn't there anyone to deal with it?"
"What happened?"
"Who can tell me?"
Dozens of experienced cultivators gathered in the square of the resettlement area and protested loudly.
They've been messing around here for hours.
Among them, law enforcement disciples also came here to inspect.
Logically speaking.
The news here should have been passed on long ago.
But no one from the Qingyun Sect showed up.
This made Li Changsheng, who was observing in the dark, very helpless.
Half an hour later.
The crowd became more and more excited.
Xu was the person behind the scenes. Seeing that the situation was getting more and more out of control, he finally appeared.
"Quiet!"
Suddenly a thunderous scolding sound exploded in everyone's ears.
Immediately afterwards.
Three streams of light fell from the sky.
The leader was dressed in brocade clothes, carrying a long sword on his back, and looked arrogant. It was Xie Jian, the elder of the general affairs department.
Xie Jian was followed by two deacons.
All are the cultivation of Dzogchen Qi.
Li Changsheng was hiding in the corner, and when he saw Xie Jian appear, his heart became more solemn.
Sure enough...
Listen up to Heaven!
After all the effort and effort to make the matter bigger, Xie Jian and his group were only attracted.
Li Changsheng complained in his heart, and then turned his attention to the two deacons next to Xie Jian.
These two deacons were not the young men who formed the formation beside Xie Jian a few days ago.
This made his frown deepen.
Because there are more people involved.
Things get more complicated.
Xie Jian stood in the sky, and the pressure of the foundation building period was released, like a mountain pressing down.
The originally noisy square.
It became silent for a moment.
The old cultivators who were clamoring for an explanation just now were all silent.
"What's the noise about?"
"I have set up a large formation for your own good."
"People have been missing frequently in the resettlement area recently. This is caused by the demonic cultivators outside causing trouble."
"The formation is to protect your safety."
This is a good reason.
The logic is also very reasonable.
Is it really just for us?
Everyone looked at each other and dared not speak in anger.
At this time Xie Jian paused and then continued:
"You have to believe in the sect."
"After the sect solves the problem of frequent disappearances of people in the resettlement area, it will naturally withdraw the formation."
"But while the formation is open, no one is allowed to leave without permission."
"If he breaks into the formation without authorization and is killed by the formation's backlash, don't blame me for not warning him."
As Xie Jian's voice fell, several veteran cultivators in the crowd shouted loudly. Xu was the sitter arranged by Xie Jian among the crowd.
"So that's it..."
"Thank you, elder, for your protection!"
"The elder is wise!"
Others saw this.
Although he still had doubts in his heart, under the pressure of Foundation Establishment, he had no choice but to agree and knelt on the ground sparsely.This is the tragedy of the weak.
Knowing it's a lie.
But he didn't even have the courage to expose it.
Xie Jian looked at the ants kneeling down below, a trace of disdain flashing in his eyes.
"Now that you understand, let's all disperse."
"Stay at home and don't run around."
"After the sect investigates clearly, the formation will naturally be removed."
After saying that, Xie Jian waved his sleeves and robe, and left with the two deacons turning into streams of light.
Only a group of old cultivators were left looking at each other.
In fact, they also knew something was wrong.
But do they dare to resist?
I dare not dare even a little bit.
Li Changsheng mingled among the crowd and couldn't help but complain.
"Demon cultivator?"
"Protect us?"
"It's really like being a bitch and building a memorial at the same time."
"I'm afraid this so-called demon cultivator is you, right?"
Then take a deep breath.
He turned around and disappeared silently into the crowd.
Back home.
Li Changsheng immediately closed the doors and windows.
In addition to the original defensive formation, another layer of [isolation from prying eyes] restrictions was added.
Jiang Cuiping was sitting by the bed sewing small clothes.
Ningning was playing next to him.
When Jiang Cuiping saw Li Changsheng coming back, she stood up with difficulty despite her big belly, went up to meet him, and asked:
"Husband, what's going on outside? I heard a big noise."
Li Changsheng held Jiang Cuiping's hand.
"It's okay."
"It's the sect elders who are here."
"It is said that there are demon cultivators outside who are making trouble. In order to protect everyone, we activated the formation."
Li Changsheng did not tell her the whole truth.
Pregnant women need to be emotionally stable.
Even if it's a white lie.
It was also to protect her and the child in her belly.
"Really?" Jiang Cuiping was a little doubtful.
"Of course it's true."
"This is at the foot of the Qingyun Sect, and the elder is also an elder of the Qingyun Sect. How could he lie to others?"
Li Changsheng smiled and scratched Jiang Cuiping's nose, his voice somewhat self-deprecating.
It's just that Jiang Cuiping, a mortal, didn't hear it at all.
"That's good..."
"As long as our family is safe and sound." Jiang Cuiping stroked her bulging belly.
"Yeah."
"We will be safe."
Li Changsheng took Jiang Cuiping into his arms, and there was a trace of love in his hunched back.
At this time, the daughter Ning Ning walked up to Li Changsheng and said in a sweet voice:
"Daddy."
"I want a hug too."
Haha...
"Okay, Ning Ning also wants a hug."
Li Changsheng said, opening his arms and taking his daughter into his arms.
"Daddy."
"Lift high."
Ning Ning wears double ponytails and her face is made up like a porcelain doll. She is very beautiful. I don’t know why, but Ning Ning has been very attached to her father since she was a child.
